prompt:

Asset type: game-ready opaque night-sky background texture for a narrow camera-clearance strip above the blue roof of a cozy low-poly sushi restaurant mobile game.
Primary request: a quiet, sparse night sky, full bleed edge to edge; dark indigo and deep muted teal-blue with extremely subtle broad angular low-poly color facets and only a few tiny subdued warm ivory stars. Match a colorful low-poly game with matte honey-colored wood and a blue tiled roof. The sky must remain visually quiet behind a phone's hole-punch camera.
Composition: very wide landscape 3:1, 1536 by 512 pixels. It will be uniformly scaled and vertically cropped into a much thinner strip. Spread sparse tiny stars, leave generous mostly empty dark sky everywhere. No important focal subject, no moon, no horizon, no silhouettes, no clouds, no architecture, no border, no text or UI, no vignette, no bright central star, no realism, no grain. Render one finished seamless-looking full-bleed sky field, opaque.
constraints: Complete original output retained; runtime is an exact byte copy.
Runtime uniformly scales and crops; no nonuniform stretching.
Quiet top strip clears camera hardware; no HUD is placed inside it.
